ky-conservation-boards.summary: The County card names the seven supervisors of your conservation district from the state's sheet for that district. The sheets name no officers, and do not say whether a supervisor won an election or was appointed to fill a vacancy.
ky-conservation-boards.why: Most supervisors take office without a vote, when no more candidates file than there are seats, and no state record names those nominees. The sheets are the only list, and each is updated on its own schedule.
ky-conservation-boards.wanted: A list of every district's supervisors that the state keeps current, with each seat's term, how it was filled and the board's officers, published as data.

ky-fiscal-court.area: Kentucky — the 48 magistrate counties this map does not draw yet
ky-fiscal-court.summary: In these counties the Magistrate or Council District layer cannot say which magisterial district you are in, so your County card lists the whole fiscal court.
ky-fiscal-court.why: No agency publishes Kentucky's magisterial districts. This app builds them from the State Board of Elections' precincts and election results, and in these counties the published results did not place every precinct in a district.
ky-fiscal-court.wanted: A magisterial district boundary file for one of these counties, or a readable copy of its 2022 general election results by precinct.

ky-legislature-roster.summary: Your Kentucky Senate and House cards name the district you are in and nobody who holds it.
ky-legislature-roster.why: The General Assembly publishes both rosters and this app has not built them yet. The cards link each chamber's own member directory instead of naming a member it has not verified.
ky-legislature-roster.wanted: Nothing from a reader — this one is ours to build.

ky-school-board-members.summary: The School Board Division layer draws the divisions of only the Jefferson and Rowan county boards of education, and no card names a school board member.
ky-school-board-members.why: No state office publishes Kentucky's school board divisions or who holds them. This app finds a county's divisions from the precincts each board race was on, and in most counties the published results cannot place every precinct.
ky-school-board-members.wanted: A list of each Kentucky school board's members by division, or a county board of education's own map or precinct list for its five divisions.
